notes: Gen 1: Slowbro's Acid Armor takes its Defense to +6; its Defense Curl then raises nothing and fails (`-fail`) — the gen1 `moveHit` returns as the boost fails, before the move's `volatileStatus`, so Slowbro has no `defensecurl` marker. Gen 2+'s `runMoveEffects` would set it all the same (`StatRules::failed_stages_end_the_move`, R-M11-106).
